svg.title: Refresh before the cached value expires
svg.desc: A cache drawer beside an expiry dial and refresh carriage. Refresh-ahead aims to reload before expiry; refresh failure still needs a freshness policy.
svg.text: Refresh before the cached value expires
The client reads the cached value.
The refresh policy identifies an entry approaching its TTL.
A refresh worker loads the current value from storage.
Replace the cache entry before expiry when refresh succeeds.
